summary: Iteration 42 — CRM restructure verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases for /leads/stats & /leads campaign_id scoping PASS. Frontend UI (Playwright, live preview URL): Office Admin, Super Admin & Staff shells all match spec — Office/Super see crm-tab-overview (default) + crm-tab-campaigns with NO separate pipeline tab; crm-overview renders crm-analytics; opening a campaign shows campaign-detail with campaign header buttons (add-leads/upload/distribute) + 4 mini stats + embedded LeadsPipeline scoped to that campaign; the pipeline HIDES its own add-lead-btn/leads-upload-btn/leads-stats when inside a campaign; adding 2 leads via campaign-add-leads-btn correctly bumped campaign-stat-total-value to 2 and rendered 2 lead-card-* items; chips (leads-filter-new), search, list/board toggles and lead-detail dialog all work scoped to the campaign; Staff sees 'My Leads' heading with leads-pipeline + leads-stats and NO crm-tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.jsx cleanly gates admins vs staff via user.role; default tab 'overview' matches spec.
LeadsPipeline correctly hides leads-stats + toolbar (add/upload) when campaignId is provided and passes campaign_id to both /leads and /leads/stats — server-side scoping verified in pytest.
CampaignsPanel re-mounts the pipeline via pipelineKey after add/upload/distribute — clean pattern to force refetch.
Backend /api/leads/stats?campaign_id and /api/leads?campaign_id honour the filter and return zero for a bogus campaign id (no 500).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all restructure checks + campaign add/search/board/detail + role scoping)

seed_data_creation: Prefixed all test data with QA_IT42_. Backend fixture cleaned up its campaigns + leads on teardown. UI-created campaign 'QA_IT42_CampA' and its 2 leads (QA_IT42_L0_*/L1_*) were cleaned via post-run script (verified 200 on all deletes). No residuals in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression for CRM restructure lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration42_crm_restructure.py. Run via `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public-url> pytest`. UI restructure verified via Playwright — key testids: crm-tabs, crm-tab-overview/campaigns, crm-overview, crm-analytics, campaign-detail, campaign-add-leads-btn/upload-btn/distribute-btn, campaign-stat-total-value, leads-pipeline (inside campaign hides add-lead-btn/leads-upload-btn/leads-stats), leads-filter-new/all/missed, leads-view-list/board, lead-card-{id}. React duplicate-key warning from iteration 41 was not reproduced in this iteration's flows. OA-dashboard 'Lead CRM' tab regression check was previously verified in iteration 41 and Leads.jsx does not touch CrmAnalytics's dashboard use.
